description: This Java class 'FileBasedConfigSupplier' provides configuration objects based on files, including environment variable handling, resource parsing, and fallback mechanisms for configuration data.

classes.name: FileBasedConfigSupplier
classes.description: A final class implementing Supplier<Config> that supplies configuration based on files, environment variables, and fallback configurations.

methods.name: forConfiguredConfigFile
methods.description: Creates an instance of FileBasedConfigSupplier based on a file path specified in an environment variable.

methods.name: fromResource
methods.description: Creates an instance of FileBasedConfigSupplier from a resource name.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the current configuration, combining initial config with optional VCAP services and secrets.

methods.name: getFileBasedConfig
methods.description: Builds the configuration by combining initial config with VCAP services and secrets.

methods.name: getSecretsAsConfig
methods.description: Retrieves secrets as a Config object.
